name: sparkx-edit-ads
description: Edit live Amazon Sponsored ad entities in bulk through the single tool `batch_update_ads` - campaign daily budget / state / bidding strategy, keyword and target status and bids, promoted products (product ads), negative keywords and negative product targets. 20 entity+action routes; 11 of them run a two-phase platform confirmation. Use when the user wants to change / pause / enable / archive / raise / lower / add / copy something on the ads themselves - 改预算 / 暂停广告 / 调价 / 加词 / 加否定词 / 投放商品 / 复制否定词. Not for AI managed groups (托管组) - creating, editing or deleting those uses sparkx-create-ai-group / sparkx-edit-ai-group / sparkx-delete-ai-group. Not for reading data (use sparkx-query-ads-performance / sparkx-query-entity-metadata).
